Synthetic, sanitized JSONL shaped against the Nuclei v3.4.10
[ResultEvent source](https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/blob/v3.4.10/pkg/output/output.go).
No template was downloaded or executed. Names, addresses and references are reserved

No engine/template version, trusted template provenance, confidence or verification
